title: Alien Trilogy
overview:
Ripley... make contact with the colony LV 426...

Bad memories are stirred up, and you hope that this is just an unfortunate oversight...

...Explore the structures in the area... clear the barricades out of the way...

...just a simple communications problem, but deep down you really know, you just don't want to admit it to yourself...

...Eliminate all aliens... destroy their nests... and burn out the egg chambers with flamethrowers...

...They're back! Facehuggers, chestbursters, dog aliens, adult aliens and...

...Find the queen, and eliminate her... whatever happens... you must eliminate the queen...

3 Queen aliens!!!... Over 30 acid-encrusted levels, an arsenal of deadly weapons, and you! The ultimate, stomach-turning 3D action of the complete Alien series makes your worst nightmares come true.
